label: Telemetry (Unified)
description: Sends live match/player/pickup telemetry to the host's local ql-telemetry-relay sidecar for stats-hub ingestion. Low-priority frame hook — designed not to cost sv_fps. Enable + configure the relay from the host's Telemetry Relay panel, then reserve this instance's server_id there.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Master switch for all telemetry sent by this plugin.

cvars.label: Position Telemetry
cvars.description: Sends live player position/view-angle telemetry for the stream overlay. Falls back to the legacy qlx_streamTelemetryEnabled cvar when unset.

cvars.label: Pickup Telemetry
cvars.description: Sends item-pickup events. Falls back to the legacy qlx_pickupTelemetryEnabled cvar when unset.

cvars.label: Pickup Telemetry Debug
cvars.description: Logs extra debug output for pickup telemetry.

cvars.label: Session Events
cvars.description: Sends player join/leave session events. Falls back to the legacy qlx_sessionEventsEnabled cvar when unset.

cvars.label: Send Interval (s)
cvars.description: Seconds between telemetry sends during normal play.

cvars.label: Idle Interval (s)
cvars.description: Seconds between telemetry sends when the match is idle/warmup.

cvars.label: Match ID Override
cvars.description: Fixed match ID to tag telemetry with, instead of an auto-generated one.

cvars.label: Server ID
cvars.description: Server ID this instance reports telemetry as, reserved via the host's Telemetry Relay panel. Must be a unique positive integer coordinated with whoever operates stats-hub - 0 (default) silently disables the whole position-telemetry feed, no error logged. Must match a telemetry-relay routes/ key on this host.

cvars.label: Tournament ID
cvars.description: Tournament ID this instance's telemetry is tagged with.
